:::{#exr-column-space-span-practice}
#### Showing that a column space is all of $\reals^2$

@thm-column-space-span describes a [column space](#def-column-space) as the [span](linear-algebra-subspaces.qmd#def-span)
of the [columns of $\matr{A}$](linear-algebra-matrices.qmd#def-matrix-column).
Let

$$
\matr{A} = \sbmat{1 & 0 & 1 \\ 0 & 1 & 1}.
$$

Show that $\mathcal{C}(\matr{A}) = \reals^2$.

::: {.callout-tip}
#### Hint

Two of the [columns of $\matr{A}$](linear-algebra-matrices.qmd#def-matrix-column) are the [indicator vectors](linear-algebra-vectors.qmd#def-indicator-vector) $\vecf{e}_1$ and $\vecf{e}_2$.

:::
